spans.text: Evac chopper approaching.
ETA 30 seconds...
...In the Dark Zone.
Hellfire and Fang? Are you talking about enemies in this game?
You'll understand once they show up. I don't know how to explain it to you now...
Are you trying to spin a story at a time like this?
No, I'm not trying to pull a fast one on you... I-I have difficulties that I can't explain!
Dima is having trouble fending off Vector's onslaught of questions, but the tension is soon broken by the beating of rotor blades—
The evac chopper is now hovering above the extraction point.
The chopper's here!
Cease fire, Vector, the enemy's coming!
Cease fire? As if I could do that!
I won't share victory with the one who killed my teammates!
But 416 isn't the one who killed your teammates!
Ahhhhhh— Dammit!
Wait, what are you doing?!
Dima jumps out of cover and waves her arms in all directions, hoping her actions will inform 416 of her desire to cease hostilities.
Whoaaa!
Gott verdammt ...What the hell is going on?
Dima... What are you doing here?
Where's that crazy Doll?
Miss Dima!
Vector pokes her head out from behind cover, her gun barrel pointed at 416.
416 is just as vigilant and levels her weapon at Vector as well.
You guys... Stop fighting already...
Please, I'm begging you...
There's a more powerful boss around!
A boss?
Yes, as I was trying to tell you, the person you met earlier...
Actually, she's—
Boom—
Dima's words are interrupted by a thunderous explosion that turns the rescue chopper into a massive fireball.
Is that...an anti-air missile?
The helicopter falls like a comet from the sky, trailing flames and smoke as it hits the plaza.
The rotor blades are snapped off by the impact and the fuselage continues careening toward the three of them.
Well, crap.
Aaaah!
Shut up and RUN!
Vector dives aside as a wave of heat washes over her.
416 roughly kicks Dima into cover and uses the momentum of the reaction force to throw herself behind another obstacle in the other direction.
Finally, the chopper grinds to a halt after hitting the main door of the UN Headquarters.
Boom—
The second explosion radiates a dazzling light, and the blast generates a powerful rolling shockwave.
By the time 416 and Vector open their bleary eyes and verify each others' position, they find that they have been surrounded by rogue agents.
Warning, extreme threat detected!
Warning...treme threat det...!

The powerful signal disruption is even affecting ISAC. His repeated words of warning bring everyone's eyes to the crash site blazing in the cold darkness of the night, where a pair of figures emerge, much to both 416 and Vector's surprise—
They see "416" and "Vector" - a pair of Dolls who are the spitting image of themselves.
"416" is holding a launcher of some sort in her raised left arm. It's plain to see that she was the one who shot down the chopper.
Meanwhile, "Vector" stands behind her, a riot shield in hand and a cold gleam in her eye. To her, the original 416 and Vector seem to be nothing more than meat for the chopping block.
...Found you at last.
The time for cleansing is nigh. The souls of the sinful shall be redeemed.
Huh? What the hell is the meaning of this?
Are you kidding me, I don't recall ever authorizing such a shoddy copy of myself to be made.
Are they different Dolls of the same model...?
Her parts seem to be different from mine.
I told you, these guys are your enemies... Hellfire Vector and Fang 416!
I didn't expect you to still be alive, Hellfire!
...Hellfire?
That Doll who looks like you is the Hellfire you're looking for.
So you weren't the one who killed R93 and K5...?
What kind of trickery is this, Miss Dima?
It's not a trick! I was trying to make up for a mistake!
Frankly speaking, if it wasn't because of game compatibility issues, I wouldn't have used your AIs, maybe a GraySkullmon would have been better...
Game compatibility? Using our AIs?
What are you talking about?
GraySkullmon...hehe, hahahaha!
Er... Cut out that creepy laugh, would you?
I see, I think I understand.
I get it now!
This way of talking, as well as this extensive knowledge of classic animated series...
That reminds me of no one other than Gr G11... UNLESS—
Sounds like you've been having fun, Dier.
Urgh! No, I'm not-!
Not going to admit it? Alright then, I'll liquidate you now, then I'll pay you a visit in person and...
N-no, please don't!
...Fine, fine, I admit it! It's me!
While I'm not too sure what exactly is going on...
The two of you seem to know each other.
And it would seem Miss Dima...no, Miss Dier is the culprit behind all this?
He's a guy.
Unforgivable.
Well, er, about this...
Ladies? Are you done chatting yet?
If you are, would you mind giving us a bit of screen time?
The fires of purification...shall burn away all your sins.
Ahhhh!
I, I promise I'll tell the truth, but could you please get rid of them first?!
...Tsk, you're pathetic.
Countless rogue agents begin gathering behind the grinning Fang.
Meanwhile, Hellfire raises her gun eagerly like a predator thirsting for blood.
You've been naughty, Miss Dima. So you recruited a couple of thieving cats to help you out.
Didn't I tell you before that I was all you need?
Bangbangbang—
A hail of gunfire threatens to pulverize the trio's cover into dust. If this were the real world, they would have been full of holes by now.
(Gags and chokes)
...What's the matter with you?
...Nothing.
I just got grossed out by how she spewed such nonsense using my face.
After shooting "Dier", who has practically curled up into a ball, another dirty look, 416 turns her attention to Vector.
They've been enemies until now, but after exchanging a glance, they nod to each other in silent accord.
You'd best prepare yourself, Dier. If you don't give us a satisfactory explanation...
I'll make you regret you were ever born.
Dier gulps as 416 and Vector both shoot him death glares.
Uh, h-here are my ammo pouch and my medical bag, p-please help yourselves.
Also...make sure you win!
